name: io.github.zizka-ai-sl/zizkadb-mcp
title: ZizkaDB
description: Causal memory and tamper-evident audit log for AI agents: log, why, search, time travel.

environmentVariables.name: ZIZKADB_HOST
environmentVariables.description: ZizkaDB API URL, e.g. http://localhost:8000 for self-hosted. Default: ZizkaDB Cloud.

environmentVariables.name: ZIZKADB_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Agent API key (zizkadb_live_...). Not needed for a local development install.

environmentVariables.name: ZIZKADB_TELEMETRY
environmentVariables.description: Set to false to turn off the anonymous install ping.
